title: Camp Geddie

services.name: Cabin Selection
services.desc: We are so excited to be offering campers a Gender Inclusive Cabin. This is to ensure that ALL campers feel included and welcome at Camp Geddie. We encourage guardians to have the discussion with their camper around which cabin best fits their needs and comfort level. You can choose to opt into up to 2 cabin options. Camp Geddie believes every person has the right to identify, express themselves and live in accordance with their authentic identity. Traditionally our cabin system has been structured according to an assumed binary gender division between male and female or “boy” and “girl” campers.
